title: AMC 10 Practice: Random Walk on a Hexagon — Visit Every Corner?
description:
AMC 10 practice problem on the expected number of random hops for a frog to visit every corner of a hexagon, solved one stage at a time. (Level 5 of 5)
A frog hops at random around a hexagon. How many jumps does it take, on average, to land on every corner? Vantee solves it one stage at a time, then shows a slick hill trick: the average wait is the steps to one exit times the steps to the other. You will see why 10, 12, 18 and 21 are tempting traps, and get an octagon challenge to try yourself.
